notes: BORDERLINE include, flagged per the vocabulary note for nutrient_mgmt_b ('flag borderline contrasts rather than excluding them'). Split-plot trial, Akonolinga (Centre Cameroon), 2015, 4 reps: control (no fertilizer), compost, poultry manure, NPK 20-10-10 x two maize varieties (tag improved_varieties is out_of_scope; variety is a factor, not the treatment, and Table 6 pools varieties). Organic-for-mineral substitution is not one of the listed efficiency practices, and the paper's comparator is no fertilizer (h10.1, excluded). If the team rules this out, the paper is exclude / no_defined_practice. Rows give compost and poultry manure against both the paper's control and the NPK arm (as the nearest acceptable comparator); NPK vs control rows not extracted (plain rate increase vs zero, out by definition). Acceptability Index (AI = NPt/NPc: compost 1.08, poultry 1.25, NPK 1.04) is a ratio of net profits, not a World Bank outcome: not extracted. Yield (Table 6 / Figure 1) not an outcome of this review.

cost_return.note: FPP = fertilizer purchase price per ha (compost 3.82 USD/bag, poultry manure 3.05 USD/bag, NPK 29.77 USD/bag of 50 kg). Table 6 values pool the two maize varieties (local and CMS 8704; control yield 1186.94 kg/ha = mean of 1.16 and 1.21 t/ha in text). Currency printed as USD. Sole season (sown March 2015, harvest 122 DAS). Organic fertilizers at 0.12 kg per planting hole (~3 t/ha per Discussion), NPK 20-10-10 at 11.2 g per plant. BORDERLINE practice: organic fertilizer (compost b29 / poultry manure b30) substituted for mineral NPK, not a listed scenario-b efficiency practice; comparator here is the paper's own control, no fertilizer (h10.1), which the vocabulary excludes as a nutrient_mgmt_b comparator.
